'''Glaci Teresinha Zancan''' (16 August 1935 – 29 June 2007) was a Brazilian [[biochemist]], president of the [[Sociedade Brasileira para o Progresso da Ciência|Brazilian Society for the Progress of the Science]] (SBPC) from 1999 to 2003.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|url=http://agencia.fapesp.br/glaci_zancan_morre_aos_72_anos/7375/|title=Glaci Zancan morre aos 72 anos|website=AGÊNCIA FAPESP|access-date=2016-05-09}}</ref> She made her post doctorate at the [[University of Buenos Aires]], when working with [[Luis Federico Leloir]], [[List of Nobel laureates in Physiology or Medicine|Nobel prize of Medicine]] of 1970.<ref name=":0"/>

== Life ==
Born in [[São Borja]], the [[scientist]] defended the increase of the female participation in research, with the universalization of research in the universities, and among others, participated in the preparation of the "National Plan of Postgrade Studies 2005–2010" coordinated by [[Coordenadoria de Aperfeiçoamento de Pessoal de Nível Superior|CAPES]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.capes.gov.br/sobre-a-capes/plano-nacional-de-pos-graduacao|title=CAPES - Coordenação de Aperfeiçoamento de Pessoal de Nível Superior - Página Inicial|website=www.capes.gov.br|access-date=2016-05-06}}</ref>

She established herself{{When?|date=January 2022}} in [[Curitiba]], being professor<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://revistaescola.abril.com.br/ciencias/fundamentos/segredo-provocar-alunos-426194.shtml|title=O segredo é provocar os alunos {{!}} Ciências {{!}} Nova Escola|website=revistaescola.abril.com.br|access-date=2016-05-06|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121215172549/http://revistaescola.abril.com.br/ciencias/fundamentos/segredo-provocar-alunos-426194.shtml|archive-date=2012-12-15|url-status=dead}}</ref> of the [[Federal University of Paraná]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.jornalcomunicacao.ufpr.br/node/1420 |title=Brasil perde uma de suas maiores pesquisadoras &#124; Comunicação On-line |access-date=2016-05-06 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120413083709/http://www.jornalcomunicacao.ufpr.br/node/1420 |archive-date=2012-04-13 |url-status=dead }}</ref> She chaired the Brazilian Society of Biochemistry, vice-president of the SBPC from 1995 to 1999 and later president from 1999 to 2003.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.unicamp.br/unicamp/unicamp_hoje/ju/maio2003/ju212pg06.html|title=Unicamp - Sala de Imprensa|website=www.unicamp.br|access-date=2016-05-06}}</ref> In her last years of life, she was member of the CAPES higher board and of the  Education Council of the State of [[Paraná (state)|Paraná.]]

== Honours ==
* She received  in 2000 the Great Cross of the National Order of Scientific Merit.<ref name=":0" />

=== [[Eponym]]s ===
* In her honour  it was instituted  the "''Trophy Women of Science Glaci Zancan''"<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.seti.pr.gov.br/modules/noticias/article.php?storyid=1062|title=Governo presta homenagem às mulheres paranaenses com o Troféu Glaci Zancan - Notícias - Secretaria da Ciência, Tecnologia e Ensino Superior|last=CELEPAR|website=www.seti.pr.gov.br|access-date=2016-05-06|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160304130107/http://www.seti.pr.gov.br/modules/noticias/article.php?storyid=1062|archive-date=2016-03-04|url-status=dead}}</ref>
